gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-kufi-arabic: Commanding from the first glance, Offside spreads its open curves across the line with no thick-and-thin fuss. And Noto Kufi Arabic follows with a modern, sans-serif hand, its c gap inviting you onward paragraph after paragraph.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans: Diagonals that weigh exactly what the verticals do give Offside its blunt, signpost character. Noto Sans follows with sturdy lowercase bodies and a wide c, and the heading earns its place when big and brief.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Offside draws its letters as if from one uniform pen, with r, n and m arches matching their stems. Then Noto Sans Adlam takes over as a plain sans with tall, full curves; headings might sit a few sizes above it.

gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-arabic: Wide, blunt and a bit bossy, Offside keeps its diagonals as stout as its stems. Noto Sans Arabic answers with a pronounced x-height and roomy openings on small letters, and that gap in personality is what makes the pairing work.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-armenian: Expressive and sign-painter plain, Offside holds every line at one weight. Noto Sans Armenian steps in with tall, full c, s and z and inviting round letters, and that welcoming body is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-avestan: Easy going and open, Noto Sans Avestan has a tall x-height and curves whose tips never touch. Over a long page it stays friendly and light, while Offside above it keeps one commanding, unvarying pen line.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-balinese: Offside stretches its plain, unshaded lines wide and lets its curves hang open, a bold sign-like look. Noto Sans Balinese tucks short ascenders and breathing room inside each curve beneath it.
